methodology.contains_active_entity_policy: Only canonical entity identifiers already present in Hosted Product Fact are reused; no new ingredient identifier namespace is invented in V2.1-8G.
methodology.identity_policy: exact product/variant/formulation/configuration reviewed independently; bundle/base differences use equivalent presentation only where base product identity is explicit
methodology.research_order: identity_gate -> official-source direct access -> target-slot adjudication -> frozen provenance -> deterministic serialization
